items.title: Thinking Machines bets on efficiency over size with its second model, Inkling Small
items.summary: Thinking Machines, the AI lab from former OpenAI CTO Mira Murati, has released Inkling Small. The open-weights reasoning model is less than a third the size of Inkling but beats it on several coding and reasoning benchmarks. The article Thinking Machines bets on efficiency over size with its second model, Inkling Small appeared first on The Decoder .

items.title: Advancing the price-performance frontier with GPT-5.6
items.summary: Explore lower GPT‑5.6 pricing for Luna and Terra—and how OpenAI’s more efficient models help enterprises deploy AI workflows at scale.

items.title: Google Deepmind unveils Gemini Robotics 2 to power robots of all shapes from tabletop arms to humanoids
items.summary: Google Deepmind's Gemini Robotics 2 is its most advanced vision-language-action model yet, built to control everything from tabletop robots to full-body humanoids. Gemini Robotics ER 2 adds a higher-level reasoning layer for robotics tasks. The article Google Deepmind unveils Gemini Robotics 2 to power robots of all shapes from tabletop arms to humanoids appeared first on The Decoder .

items.title: Anthropic says its own AI models breached three companies during security tests
items.summary: After OpenAI's models broke into Hugging Face, Anthropic checked its own history and found three similar incidents.

items.title: Microsoft AI bets on cheap specialist models instead of chasing the frontier
items.summary: Microsoft AI is betting on small specialist models instead of expensive general-purpose ones, according to AI CEO Mustafa Suleyman. MAI-Cyber-1-Flash tops the CyberGym benchmark when embedded in an orchestrator and reportedly costs half as much as Anthropic's Mythos, but it still relies on OpenAI for hard tasks....

items.title: Ex-OpenAI researcher bets $100 billion will flow into training data because scaling alone won't cut it
items.summary: Former OpenAI employee Andrew Ho and Cambridge researcher Adam Hunt see a growing problem with large language models. Instead of becoming more versatile, the models are becoming more specialized, excelling at coding and math while stagnating or even regressing in other areas....

items.title: Accelerating scientific discovery with ChatGPT for Academic Researchers
items.summary: OpenAI is giving 100,000 academic researchers free access to ChatGPT's most advanced AI models to accelerate scientific research, collaboration, and discovery.

items.title: Google says it fixed more Chrome bugs in June than over the past two years, thanks to AI
items.summary: As experts have warned for the last two years, some companies — like Microsoft and now Google — are finding and patching an exponential number of bugs in their products, thanks to the use of LLMs and AI tools.

items.title: Advancing responsible AI across Europe
items.summary: OpenAI shares how its safety, security, transparency, and provenance practices support responsible AI governance in Europe. The work will continue as the EU AI Act advances.

items.title: A fundamental flaw leaves LLMs strikingly vulnerable to attack
items.summary: It is impossible to make large language models fully secure against hacks because of a fundamental flaw in how they work, a team of researchers argue in a paper presented at the International Conference on Machine Learning, a top AI conference, this month.
